text: Figure 8.21: Configuration of the calibration for the SwComponentType The foreign reference RteComponentTypeRef identifies the SwComponentType (which is limited to ParameterSwComponentType and AtomicSwComponentType). The boolean parameter RteCalibrationSupportEnabled specifies whether calibration shall be enabled for the specified SwComponentType.
